title: Knowledge run previews bulk writes before they go live
description: After 1,366 mostly junk wiki pages reached Machines on Machines on 11-02. A site's first knowledge run produces a preview (what it would publish, a sample by kind) for a person to approve before writing. Later runs proceed unless output differs sharply from the site's own history, using a learned comparison, not a fixed cap. Ryan approved 11-02: knowledge-run rollouts to more sites hold until this and the run-id story are done. Gherkin specs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on feature/PPY-84b0dd-knowledge-run-preview, PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/1059 (builds on PR 1058 for PPY-5b5a5d). wiki-sync plans first (wiki sync --json) and a gate (knowledge_cloud/preview_gate.py) holds the first run of a site, or one unlike the site's own history (negative binomial tail below 1/((n+1)*k), mean and spread learned from earlier runs), as a hard-gate review request in the Notification Center; approval is the console or papyrus reviews answer, no AWS login. A held run writes nothing and projection skips its execution. Tests: preview_gate_test.py (18), preview_stages_test.py (10), features_backend/knowledge-run-preview.feature (11 scenarios). Not deployed: needs a release, a rebuilt knowledge-run image and its deploy. Quality follow-up filed: PPY-7d309b.
